easy: A long, fancy dress that a woman wears to a special party.

ex.en: The queen wore a long blue gown to the ball.
ex.ko: 여왕은 무도회에 긴 파란색 드레스를 입고 갔다.

easy: In the best way it could possibly be.

ex.en: Ideally, we should finish our homework before dinner.
ex.ko: 이상적으로는 저녁 먹기 전에 숙제를 끝내는 게 좋다.

easy: On the inside, not on the outside.

ex.en: The apple looked fine, but it was rotten internally.
ex.ko: 그 사과는 멀쩡해 보였지만 속은 썩어 있었다.

easy: On the side, or going toward the side.

ex.en: The lateral branches of the tree grew out to the side.
ex.ko: 나무의 옆 가지들이 옆으로 뻗어 자랐다.

easy: Lasting for your whole life.

ex.en: Mia and Joon are lifelong friends.
ex.ko: 미아와 준은 평생 친구다.

easy: A baseball hit hard in a straight line, not high in the air.

ex.en: The batter hit a liner right to the shortstop.
ex.ko: 타자가 유격수 쪽으로 직선 타구를 쳤다.

easy: The top level of baseball teams, where the best players play.

ex.en: My dream is to play in the majors someday.
ex.ko: 내 꿈은 언젠가 메이저리그에서 뛰는 것이다.

easy: Moving from place to place, often to find work.

ex.en: Migrant workers pick fruit on the farms in summer.
ex.ko: 이주 노동자들은 여름에 농장에서 과일을 딴다.

easy: A person who moves from one place or country to live somewhere else.

ex.en: My grandmother was a migrant who came to America as a girl.
ex.ko: 우리 할머니는 어릴 때 미국으로 온 이주민이었다.

easy: A thick wet paste that hardens and holds bricks or stones together.

ex.en: The worker spread mortar between the bricks.
ex.ko: 일꾼이 벽돌 사이에 모르타르를 발랐다.

easy: Trusting and simple, and not knowing much about how the world works.

ex.en: Tom was naive and believed his brother's silly story.
ex.ko: 톰은 순진해서 형의 터무니없는 이야기를 믿었다.

easy: Easy to see or notice.

ex.en: The red balloon was noticeable in the gray sky.
ex.ko: 회색 하늘에서 빨간 풍선이 눈에 띄었다.

easy: Big enough that you can tell it is there.

ex.en: There was a noticeable smell of pizza in the kitchen.
ex.ko: 부엌에서 피자 냄새가 뚜렷하게 났다.

easy: Good at noticing small things around you.

ex.en: Ella is an observant girl, and she spotted the tiny frog right away.
ex.ko: 엘라는 관찰력이 좋아서 작은 개구리를 바로 찾아냈다.

easy: A liquid with a sweet smell that people put on their skin.

ex.en: Mom put on perfume before the party.
ex.ko: 엄마는 파티 전에 향수를 뿌렸다.

easy: Throwing the ball to the batter in baseball.

ex.en: My brother loves pitching, and he throws very fast.
ex.ko: 우리 형은 투구를 아주 좋아하고 공을 아주 빠르게 던진다.

easy: Making you feel happy and glad.

ex.en: Winning the game was a pleasing surprise.
ex.ko: 경기에서 이긴 것은 기분 좋은 놀라움이었다.

easy: Nice to smell, taste, hear, or see.

ex.en: The cookies had a pleasing smell.
ex.ko: 쿠키에서 기분 좋은 냄새가 났다.

easy: The respect people give to someone or something important or successful.

ex.en: Winning the spelling contest gave her great prestige at school.
ex.ko: 철자 대회에서 우승해서 그녀는 학교에서 큰 명망을 얻었다.

easy: How much something has to do with the thing you are talking about.

ex.en: Your story about dogs has no relevance to our science lesson.
ex.ko: 개 이야기는 우리 과학 수업과 관련이 없다.

easy: Even a tiny bit.

ex.en: I am not remotely hungry after eating three slices of pizza.
ex.ko: 나는 피자를 세 조각이나 먹어서 조금도 배고프지 않다.

easy: A person or store that sells things to shoppers.

ex.en: The toy retailer at the mall sells lots of puzzles.
ex.ko: 쇼핑몰의 장난감 소매점은 퍼즐을 많이 판다.

easy: Hard and not able to bend.

ex.en: A ruler is rigid, so it does not bend.
ex.ko: 자는 단단해서 구부러지지 않는다.

easy: Following rules in a very strict way and not willing to change.

ex.en: Our coach has rigid rules about being on time.
ex.ko: 우리 코치님은 시간 지키기에 대해 엄격한 규칙이 있다.

easy: To take a picture of what you see on a computer or phone screen.

ex.en: I took a screenshot of my high score to show Dad.
ex.ko: 나는 아빠에게 보여주려고 최고 점수 화면을 캡처했다.

easy: Completely broken or ruined.

ex.en: The rain ended our picnic, and our plans were shattered.
ex.ko: 비 때문에 소풍이 취소되어 우리 계획은 산산이 무너졌다.

easy: A vehicle that travels in outer space.

ex.en: The spacecraft flew around the moon.
ex.ko: 우주선이 달 주위를 날았다.

easy: How thick something is, from one side to the other side.

ex.en: We measured the thickness of the book with a ruler.
ex.ko: 우리는 자로 책의 두께를 쟀다.

easy: A flat object with low edges for carrying food or things.

ex.en: I carried my lunch on a tray in the cafeteria.
ex.ko: 나는 급식실에서 쟁반에 점심을 담아 날랐다.

easy: Not fair or not sensible.

ex.en: It is unreasonable to expect a puppy to sit still all day.
ex.ko: 강아지가 하루 종일 가만히 앉아 있기를 바라는 건 말이 안 된다.

easy: Not feeling sure of yourself.

ex.en: Ben felt unsure about singing in front of the class.
ex.ko: 벤은 반 친구들 앞에서 노래하는 것이 자신 없었다.

easy: Toward a higher place.

ex.en: The balloon floated upwards into the sky.
ex.ko: 풍선이 하늘 위로 떠올랐다.

easy: The price someone says something is worth.

ex.en: The valuation of our house was higher than we thought.
ex.ko: 우리 집의 평가액은 우리가 생각한 것보다 높았다.

easy: Having to do with doctors who take care of animals.

ex.en: We took our cat to the veterinary clinic.
ex.ko: 우리는 고양이를 동물병원에 데려갔다.

easy: A doctor who takes care of sick animals.

ex.en: The veterinarian checked our dog's sore paw.
ex.ko: 수의사 선생님이 우리 강아지의 아픈 발을 살펴보았다.

easy: To not match a rule, like a rule for writing.

ex.en: A sentence with no verb violates the rules of grammar.
ex.ko: 동사가 없는 문장은 문법 규칙에 어긋난다.

easy: To break a rule, law, or promise.

ex.en: Running in the hall violates the school rules.
ex.ko: 복도에서 뛰는 것은 학교 규칙을 어기는 것이다.

easy: Moving your hand from side to side to say hello or goodbye.

ex.en: We saw Grandma's waving from the bus window.
ex.ko: 우리는 버스 창문 너머로 할머니가 손 흔드는 모습을 보았다.

easy: Showing that you think someone did something wrong.

ex.en: Mom gave me an accusing look when she saw the broken cup.
ex.ko: 엄마는 깨진 컵을 보고 나를 나무라는 눈빛으로 쳐다보았다.

easy: A part of something that is set aside for a certain use.

ex.en: Each class got an allocation of ten new books.
ex.ko: 각 반은 새 책 열 권씩을 배정받았다.

easy: Giving out parts of something by a plan.

ex.en: The allocation of seats on the bus was done by the teacher.
ex.ko: 버스 좌석 배정은 선생님이 했다.

easy: The happy feeling you get when something is fun or funny.

ex.en: The clown's tricks filled us with amusement.
ex.ko: 광대의 재주에 우리는 아주 즐거워했다.

easy: Waiting for something good with excitement.

ex.en: We waited for the first day of summer with great anticipation.
ex.ko: 우리는 여름방학이 시작되는 날을 크게 기대하며 기다렸다.

easy: The right to tell others what to do.

ex.en: The principal has the authority to close the school for snow.
ex.ko: 교장 선생님은 눈이 오면 학교를 쉬게 할 권한이 있다.

easy: Extra, and there to help.

ex.en: We keep an auxiliary light in case the power goes out.
ex.ko: 우리는 정전에 대비해 예비 전등을 둔다.

easy: Bags and suitcases that you take on a trip.

ex.en: Our baggage was heavy when we flew to Korea.
ex.ko: 우리가 한국에 갈 때 짐이 무거웠다.

easy: A big fire on a hill that people can see from far away.

ex.en: Long ago, people lit a beacon on the hill to send a warning.
ex.ko: 옛날에 사람들은 경고를 보내려고 언덕에 봉화를 피웠다.

easy: A large amount of good things.

ex.en: The farm had a bounty of apples this fall.
ex.ko: 올가을 농장에는 사과가 풍성했다.

easy: A person who fights with fists in a sport, wearing big gloves.

ex.en: The boxer put on his gloves and stepped into the ring.
ex.ko: 권투 선수는 글러브를 끼고 링에 올랐다.

easy: A short talk that gives people the information they need before a job.

ex.en: The coach gave a short briefing before the game.
ex.ko: 코치님은 경기 전에 짧게 작전을 설명해 주었다.

easy: A small stream of water, smaller than a river.

ex.en: We caught tiny fish in the brook.
ex.ko: 우리는 개울에서 작은 물고기를 잡았다.

easy: Made of clay that is baked hard.

ex.en: Grandma's ceramic bowl is blue and white.
ex.ko: 할머니의 도자기 그릇은 파란색과 흰색이다.

easy: A hard object made from clay baked in a very hot oven.

ex.en: We made a ceramic cup in art class.
ex.ko: 우리는 미술 시간에 도자기 컵을 만들었다.

easy: A plant like wheat or rice whose seeds people eat.

ex.en: Rice is a cereal that grows in wet fields.
ex.ko: 쌀은 물이 찬 논에서 자라는 곡물이다.

easy: A sweet, bubbly brown soft drink.

ex.en: Dad drank a cola with his burger.
ex.ko: 아빠는 햄버거와 함께 콜라를 마셨다.

easy: A very deep sleep that a person cannot wake up from because of being very sick or hurt.

ex.en: After the accident, the man was in a coma for a week.
ex.ko: 사고 후 그 남자는 일주일 동안 혼수상태였다.

easy: Feeling calm and relaxed, without worry.

ex.en: Mina spoke comfortably in front of the class.
ex.ko: 미나는 반 친구들 앞에서 편안하게 말했다.

easy: In a way that feels soft, cozy, and good for your body.

ex.en: The cat slept comfortably on the warm blanket.
ex.ko: 고양이는 따뜻한 담요 위에서 편안히 잤다.

easy: Showing that you think someone is not worth any respect.

ex.en: She showed contempt for anyone who cheated.
ex.ko: 그녀는 부정행위를 하는 사람을 경멸했다.

easy: When something goes away and you cannot see it anymore.

ex.en: The magician's trick was the disappearance of a rabbit.
ex.ko: 마술사는 토끼가 사라지는 마술을 보여 주었다.

easy: All the living things in a place and how they live together with the land and water.

ex.en: Cutting down the trees changed the ecology of the forest.
ex.ko: 나무를 베자 숲의 생태가 바뀌었다.

easy: The study of how plants and animals live with each other and with nature.

ex.en: In ecology class we learned that frogs need clean ponds.
ex.ko: 생태학 시간에 개구리가 깨끗한 연못이 필요하다는 것을 배웠다.

easy: The slow start of something new.

ex.en: The emergence of cell phones changed how we talk to friends.
ex.ko: 휴대폰의 등장은 우리가 친구와 이야기하는 방식을 바꿨다.

easy: The moment something comes out and can be seen.

ex.en: The emergence of the butterfly from its cocoon was amazing.
ex.ko: 고치에서 나비가 나오는 모습은 놀라웠다.

easy: Closed in on all sides.

ex.en: We ate lunch on the enclosed porch because of the rain.
ex.ko: 비가 와서 우리는 막힌 베란다에서 점심을 먹었다.

easy: The strength to keep going when something is hard or tiring.

ex.en: Running a long race takes a lot of endurance.
ex.ko: 긴 달리기를 하려면 지구력이 많이 필요하다.

easy: Leaving a place quickly and safely because of danger.

ex.en: During the fire drill, the evacuation of the school took five minutes.
ex.ko: 소방 훈련 때 학교 대피에 5분이 걸렸다.

easy: Much more than usual.

ex.en: It was exceptionally cold on the morning of our trip.
ex.ko: 소풍 날 아침은 유난히 추웠다.

easy: Traded for something else.

ex.en: I wore the exchanged sneakers, and they fit much better.
ex.ko: 교환한 운동화는 훨씬 잘 맞았다.

easy: The act of spending money.

ex.en: Our family's biggest expenditure is food.
ex.ko: 우리 가족의 가장 큰 지출은 식비다.

easy: A bird that hunts, with long pointed wings, that flies very fast.

ex.en: The falcon zoomed across the sky.
ex.ko: 매가 하늘을 쌩 가로질러 날았다.

easy: A cover made of folded paper or plastic that keeps papers safe.

ex.en: I keep my homework in a blue folder.
ex.ko: 나는 숙제를 파란색 폴더에 넣어 둔다.

easy: Very scared.

ex.en: The frightened puppy hid under the bed during the thunder.
ex.ko: 겁에 질린 강아지는 천둥이 칠 때 침대 밑에 숨었다.

easy: A long, thin line cut into a surface.

ex.en: The marble rolled along the groove in the wood.
ex.ko: 구슬이 나무에 판 홈을 따라 굴러갔다.

easy: One of the things you mix together to make something, like food.

ex.en: Flour is the main ingredient in bread.
ex.ko: 밀가루는 빵의 주재료다.

easy: To start something new.

ex.en: Our class initiated a recycling program.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 재활용 활동을 시작했다.

easy: To take the lead and be the first to start something.

ex.en: Ava initiated a clean-up day at the park.
ex.ko: 에이바는 공원 청소의 날을 주도했다.

easy: In a way that is the opposite of what you would expect.

ex.en: Ironically, the fastest runner lost the race to the slowest one.
ex.ko: 아이러니하게도 가장 빠른 선수가 가장 느린 선수에게 경주에서 졌다.

easy: Saying the opposite of what you mean, as a joke.

ex.en: "Great job," he said ironically when I dropped the ice cream.
ex.ko: "정말 잘했네." 그는 내가 아이스크림을 떨어뜨리자 비꼬듯이 말했다.

easy: The unhappy feeling when you want what someone else has.

ex.en: Tim felt jealousy when his friend got a new bike.
ex.ko: 팀은 친구가 새 자전거를 받자 질투를 느꼈다.

easy: A person who likes to tell jokes and play tricks.

ex.en: My uncle is a real joker who makes us laugh.
ex.ko: 우리 삼촌은 우리를 웃게 만드는 장난꾸러기다.

easy: To show something by moving your head down and up.

ex.en: Mom nodded her approval when I cleaned my room.
ex.ko: 엄마는 내가 방을 치우자 고개를 끄덕이며 칭찬해 주었다.

easy: To move your head down and up to say yes.

ex.en: The teacher nodded when Jin gave the right answer.
ex.ko: 진이 정답을 말하자 선생님은 고개를 끄덕였다.

easy: A book with empty pages for writing notes.

ex.en: I wrote my spelling words in my notebook.
ex.ko: 나는 공책에 받아쓰기 단어를 적었다.

easy: A small computer that you can carry and fold shut.

ex.en: Dad opened his notebook on the train.
ex.ko: 아빠는 기차에서 노트북을 열었다.

easy: A flat board that an artist uses to mix paints.

ex.en: She mixed blue and yellow on her palette to make green.
ex.ko: 그녀는 팔레트에서 파랑과 노랑을 섞어 초록을 만들었다.

easy: A sickness in the lungs that makes it hard to breathe.

ex.en: My cousin was in the hospital with pneumonia.
ex.ko: 내 사촌은 폐렴으로 병원에 입원했다.

easy: A man whose job is to keep people safe and make sure they follow the law.

ex.en: The policeman helped us cross the street.
ex.ko: 경찰관 아저씨가 우리가 길을 건너는 것을 도와주었다.

easy: Coming right before.

ex.en: Read the preceding page again if you feel lost.
ex.ko: 헷갈리면 앞 페이지를 다시 읽어 봐.

easy: Having a lot of rain.

ex.en: We stayed inside on the rainy afternoon.
ex.ko: 비 오는 오후에 우리는 집 안에 있었다.

easy: Fixing an old building or room to make it look new again.

ex.en: Our kitchen renovation took two months.
ex.ko: 우리 집 부엌 리모델링은 두 달이 걸렸다.

easy: Giving you a good feeling because it is worth doing.

ex.en: Helping at the animal shelter is a rewarding job.
ex.ko: 동물 보호소에서 돕는 일은 보람 있다.

easy: Having a lot of salt in it.

ex.en: The ocean water tasted salty.
ex.ko: 바닷물은 짠맛이 났다.

easy: A long, careful look at something.

ex.en: Under the judge's scrutiny, the dancer felt nervous.
ex.ko: 심사위원의 날카로운 눈길 아래서 무용수는 긴장했다.

easy: A shoe with a blade or wheels so you can glide along.

ex.en: I tied my skates and glided across the ice.
ex.ko: 나는 스케이트 끈을 묶고 얼음 위를 미끄러져 갔다.

easy: The main story of a book, play, or movie.

ex.en: The storyline of the movie is about a lost puppy.
ex.ko: 그 영화의 줄거리는 길 잃은 강아지 이야기다.

easy: To wander away from where you should be.

ex.en: The little lamb strayed away from the flock.
ex.ko: 새끼 양이 무리에서 벗어나 헤맸다.

easy: The meal you eat in the evening.

ex.en: We eat supper at six o'clock.
ex.ko: 우리는 여섯 시에 저녁을 먹는다.

easy: A very kind person that everyone likes.

ex.en: Our bus driver is a sweetheart and always smiles.
ex.ko: 우리 버스 기사님은 정말 다정해서 늘 웃어 주신다.

easy: How fast or slow music is played.

ex.en: The band played the song at a fast tempo.
ex.ko: 밴드는 그 노래를 빠른 템포로 연주했다.

easy: How fast something happens again and again.

ex.en: Keep a steady tempo while you jump rope.
ex.ko: 줄넘기를 할 때는 일정한 속도를 유지해라.

easy: Needing to drink water.

ex.en: After soccer practice, I was so thirsty.
ex.ko: 축구 연습이 끝난 뒤 나는 목이 너무 말랐다.

easy: A stick with fire on the end that you carry to give light.

ex.en: The explorers carried a torch into the dark cave.
ex.ko: 탐험가들은 어두운 동굴로 횃불을 들고 들어갔다.

easy: Staying the same.

ex.en: The rules of the game stayed unchanged.
ex.ko: 게임 규칙은 변하지 않았다.

easy: Still the way it was at the start.

ex.en: Grandpa's old house is unchanged after fifty years.
ex.ko: 할아버지의 옛집은 오십 년이 지나도 그대로다.

easy: Easy to understand.

ex.en: The story was short and understandable.
ex.ko: 그 이야기는 짧고 이해하기 쉬웠다.

easy: Standing straight up, not leaning.

ex.en: The flagpole stood upright in the wind.
ex.ko: 깃대는 바람 속에서도 똑바로 서 있었다.

easy: Honest and doing what is right.

ex.en: An upright person tells the truth even when it is hard.
ex.ko: 올바른 사람은 어려울 때도 진실을 말한다.

easy: Too proud of how you look or what you can do.

ex.en: The vain prince looked in the mirror all day.
ex.ko: 허영심 많은 왕자는 하루 종일 거울만 보았다.

easy: Not working, even though you tried hard.

ex.en: We made a vain search for the lost key.
ex.ko: 우리는 잃어버린 열쇠를 헛되이 찾아다녔다.

easy: Being too proud of yourself, especially of how you look.

ex.en: Her vanity made her check the mirror every minute.
ex.ko: 허영심 때문에 그녀는 일 분마다 거울을 들여다보았다.

easy: A musical instrument with four strings that you play with a bow.

ex.en: My sister plays the violin in the school orchestra.
ex.ko: 우리 누나는 학교 오케스트라에서 바이올린을 연주한다.

easy: Good enough to be worth your time.

ex.en: The long walk to see the waterfall was worthwhile.
ex.ko: 폭포를 보려고 먼 길을 걸은 것은 가치가 있었다.

easy: When something starts to happen faster and faster.

ex.en: There was an acceleration in the race when the runners saw the finish line.
ex.ko: 결승선이 보이자 달리기가 점점 빨라졌다.

easy: Making something go faster.

ex.en: The car's acceleration pushed us back in our seats.
ex.ko: 자동차가 가속하자 우리는 좌석에 몸이 쏠렸다.

easy: The air around Earth and outer space, all together.

ex.en: Her uncle builds rockets in the aerospace industry.
ex.ko: 그녀의 삼촌은 항공우주 산업에서 로켓을 만든다.

easy: Good at thinking about the small parts of something to understand it.

ex.en: Jin is analytical and loves solving puzzles.
ex.ko: 진은 분석적이어서 퍼즐 푸는 것을 좋아한다.

easy: To get ready for something before it happens.

ex.en: We anticipated the rain and brought umbrellas.
ex.ko: 우리는 비를 예상하고 우산을 챙겼다.

easy: A covered walkway with shops on both sides.

ex.en: We walked through the arcade to get ice cream.
ex.ko: 우리는 아케이드를 지나 아이스크림을 먹으러 갔다.

easy: A line of arches held up by columns.

ex.en: The old building has an arcade along the front.
ex.ko: 그 오래된 건물은 앞쪽에 아치형 회랑이 있다.

easy: A sickness that makes it hard to breathe.

ex.en: My brother uses an inhaler for his asthma.
ex.ko: 내 동생은 천식 때문에 흡입기를 쓴다.

easy: Colorful lights that move in the sky near the far north or south.

ex.en: We saw green lights, the aurora, dancing in the sky.
ex.ko: 우리는 하늘에서 춤추는 초록빛 오로라를 보았다.

easy: Having to do with tiny living things called germs.

ex.en: A bacterial infection made my throat sore.
ex.ko: 세균 감염 때문에 목이 아팠다.

easy: Having no money left to pay what you owe.

ex.en: The small shop became bankrupt and had to close.
ex.ko: 그 작은 가게는 파산해서 문을 닫아야 했다.

easy: A person who has no money to pay what they owe.

ex.en: The bankrupt sold his car to pay his debts.
ex.ko: 파산한 그 사람은 빚을 갚으려고 차를 팔았다.

easy: To close and open your eyes very fast.

ex.en: Don't blink, or you will miss the magic trick!
ex.ko: 눈 깜박하지 마, 안 그러면 마술을 놓칠 거야!

easy: To blink fast so that tears go away.

ex.en: Sam blinked away his tears and smiled.
ex.ko: 샘은 눈을 깜박여 눈물을 참고 웃었다.

easy: Acting like a much younger child.

ex.en: Throwing a fit over a game is childish.
ex.ko: 게임 때문에 떼쓰는 것은 유치하다.

easy: A spicy food made with beef, beans, and tomatoes.

ex.en: We had hot chili for dinner on the cold night.
ex.ko: 추운 밤에 우리는 따끈한 칠리를 저녁으로 먹었다.

easy: Something wound around in circles.

ex.en: A coil of rope lay on the dock.
ex.ko: 밧줄 한 사리가 부두에 놓여 있었다.

easy: An idea someone says is true in an argument.

ex.en: Her contention was that recess should be longer.
ex.ko: 그녀의 주장은 쉬는 시간이 더 길어야 한다는 것이었다.

easy: A written promise signed by two groups or countries.

ex.en: The two countries signed a covenant to keep the peace.
ex.ko: 두 나라는 평화를 지키기로 협약을 맺었다.
